description: Mining profitability calculator using live chain difficulty and the Monero tail-emission reward: gross XMR per day/month, power cost, net USD profit, break-even XMR price, break-even electricity price and hardware ROI days. When to use: decide whether a given hashrate is worth running at a power price, or to explain why XMR mining economics changed. Do not use: for pool share accounting (this service runs no pool) or price prediction. Returns: network{}, gross_xmr{}, power{}, usd{}, profitable, roi_days, break-even fields.
